Who We Are

Our DNA

At the intersection of financial precision and agile delivery, our firm provides elite managerial consultancy services designed to modernize your back-office operations. With over 11 years of proven expertise, we bridge the gap between complex legacy processes and high-performing, cloud-integrated financial ecosystems.

We specialize in the heavy hitters of enterprise resource planning (ERP) and project management, ensuring your data flows seamlessly and your projects finish on time. Our background combines Big Four consulting at Deloitte and PwC with hands-on delivery: full-lifecycle implementations, multi-entity roll-outs and application management on SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC and Oracle Cloud ERP for international groups in Manufacturing, Automotive, Energy, Retail and Fashion, Financial Services and Utilities.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What does Vantage Finance & Tech do?

We are a managerial consultancy focused on finance back-office modernization. Our six core services are Oracle Cloud ERP Finance, SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI-CO), treasury, banking and cash management, financial reporting and compliance, integration and finance data, and PMO & project management support.

Which ERP systems do you work with?

SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC FI-CO, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable and Receivable, Asset Accounting, Controlling, Bank Accounting, Cash Management, Central Finance, MDG, SAP Fiori and SAP VIM. On the Oracle side, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Financials, Procure-to-Pay, Oracle Analytics Cloud and JD Edwards.

Which industries do you have experience in?

Manufacturing, automotive, energy and oil & gas, retail and fashion, financial services and utilities, for international groups in Europe, the Middle East and Asia. You can download a reference document for several of these industries in the Guides section above.

Do you support e-invoicing and local requirements?

Yes. E-invoicing and country localizations are among our focus areas, on both SAP S/4HANA and Oracle Fusion ERP, including Italy's new Consolidated VAT Act (Legislative Decree 10/2026). Our localization guide covers Italy, Spain, France, Germany and the United Kingdom.

Can you help with IFRS 18 in SAP S/4HANA?

Yes. IFRS 18 applies from 1 January 2027 and requires a new income statement structure. We design the financial statement versions with the Operating, Investing and Financing categories and the new subtotals, map G/L accounts and functional areas, and build the reporting by functional area, keeping the IAS 1 view in parallel during the transition.

Do you work on treasury and cash pooling?

Yes. We cover Bank Accounting and electronic bank statements, Bank Account Management, payment programs and cash pooling in SAP S/4HANA with Cash Concentration and In-House Cash / In-House Banking.

Where are you based and how can I contact you?

We are based in Rivalta di Torino (Turin), Italy. Call +39 327 930 4297 or use the details in the contact section.
